omopColumns.name: nhs_number

dataSource.name: patient_identifier_value
dataSource.description: Patient NHS number, used to join existing OMOP Person records.

omopColumns.query:
select
    patient_identifier_value,
    clinical_date,
    clinical_datetime,
    clinical_code,
    trim(clinical_code) as concept_code
from ##duckdb_source##
where upper(trim(clinical_code_system)) = 'SNOMED CT'
order by all
